name: stockly
description: Stockly - inventory management platform: Android app, responsive website, one shared backend.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:website && npm run build:mobile
scripts.build:website: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @stockly/website
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @stockly/mobile
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/api-response.test.ts tests/releases.test.ts tests/user-registry.test.ts tests/admin-auth.test.ts tests/device-link.test.ts tests/auth.test.ts
scripts.android:build: npm run build:mobile && npm run cap:sync && node scripts/build-apk.mjs
